③两种读法都可以：后续「か」、「に」、「と」、「で」。后续「と」的时候，一般情况下两种读法都可以，但是「何という」这个同语里，只发「なん」的音。

meaningVi: Ngay cả / Thậm chí
meaningEn:
An adverb/conjunction that represents the idea of "additionally" or "further". 

 [意味]
  Even ~er; even more; additional; more; further; furthermore; in addition 

 [例文A] 
  (ksa).　更に大きいハリケーンがテキサス南部を襲

meaningEn:
末（に）A noun that indicates the end of a period or the time after long, hard mental or physical work. 

 [意味]
  After; at the end of 

 [例文A] 
  (ksa).　さんざん迷った末に、友達の結婚祝いはコーヒーカップのセットを贈ることにした。
 After much

meaningVi: Ngay cả / Thậm chí
meaningEn:
An adverb to introduce an event which takes place contrary to one's expectation/intention, or an action or event which is converse to that stated in the preceding sentence or clause. 

 [意味]
 Contrary
